º Have a master's degree in law, ideally in relation to the energy or contract law,

º Are passionate about energy industry, in particular renewable energy and energy storage as well as artificial intelligence,

º Are striving to grow and develop your legal skills,

º Are proficient in English and German,

º Have a pro-active, solution-oriented attitude and a collaborative mind-set.
